gate: Run only when parent authorizes integrated RC. Use isolated synthetic fixtures, never human profiles.
controls: Local party or stored box Pokemon > Summary > Pokemon Skills > SELECT. SELECT or B closes detail only. Close before changing pages or Pokemon.

cases.steps: Open a local non-egg party Pokemon Summary. Move right to Skills. Observe SELECT: IV/EV. Press SELECT.
cases.expect: Native in-game panel displays Stat, IV, EV, all six named stats, Hidden Power type and power. Hint changes to SELECT/B: Back. No web UI or telemetry is needed. Text fits without row overlap or clipping.

cases.steps: Use distinct synthetic IVs and EVs in HP, Attack, Defense, Speed, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def, including stored EV values 0, 1, 252, 253, 254 and 255. Inspect the panel.
cases.expect: Every value matches its named stored MON_DATA field exactly, including 253-255. Nothing is clamped or recalculated. No total EV or per-stat cap is modified.

cases.steps: Inspect all-zero IVs, then all-31 IVs in separate synthetic Pokemon, whether or not Hidden Power is learned.
cases.expect: All-zero IVs show Fighting with power 30. All-31 IVs show Dark with power 70. The displayed type never includes Normal or Mystery.

cases.steps: After authorization, run the focused helper test and compare mixed IV fixtures with the existing Cmd_hiddenpowercalc formula. Include Speed, Sp. Atk and Sp. Def differing in both low bits.
cases.expect: Helper covers every low-two-bit combination with unchanged results after setting upper IV bits. Native UI displays the corresponding type name and power. No battle state is written by inspection.

cases.steps: With detail open press each direction, A and L/R. Close with SELECT, reopen, close with B, then change party member and page and return. Repeat opening and closing. Finally close Summary.
cases.expect: Navigation is ignored while modal. SELECT and B close only detail, restoring item, ribbons, stats and EXP without tile corruption. The next open reflects the newly selected Pokemon. Hint exists only on Skills. Normal Summary B-close works after the modal closes. No window or tile allocation leak.

cases.steps: Inspect a real local stored-box array Pokemon and a legitimately traded Pokemon now in the local party with a different OT. Also inspect an arbitrary temporary copy including a held moving-box Pokemon.
cases.expect: Real local box and traded-local party can show details. Temporary summary copies have no hint and SELECT does nothing. Ownership is based on trusted local storage, not OT name or ID.

cases.steps: Exercise a partner trade summary, local lock-moves trade summary, multi battle, shared co-op temporary party, regular in-battle Summary, Battle Factory and Slateport Battle Tent rental summary.
cases.expect: No detail hint or panel in any of these contexts. SELECT must not expose another trainer's IVs or EVs, including when gPlayerParty temporarily contains mixed-owner battle data. No private party telemetry or protocol change.

cases.steps: Use synthetic egg and bad-egg fixtures and an instrumented window allocation failure when opening detail.
cases.expect: Eggs and bad eggs have no detail hint or panel. Allocation failure leaves normal Skills usable without invalid window access.

cases.steps: Compare isolated party and storage bytes before and after repeated inspection. Run parent integrated native build and authorized GBA ROM neutrality checks against the pinned base.
cases.expect: Inspection leaves party, box and saved Pokemon data unchanged. Global MAX_PER_STAT_EVS remains 255. All shared-source additions are PORTABLE guarded. GBA output matches the baseline when checked by the established toolchain.
